notes.title: Update 4 Has Just Gone Live!
notes.notes:
We've spent the last few months working on This Means Warp's biggest ever update, and are looking forward to hearing what you think!

Update 4 Release Notes
Boarding
One of the top player requested features finally arrives in This Means Warp! The new Teleporter system enables players to board and cause havoc on enemy ships, but be careful - enemy crews might do the same to you!

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/4b6e41bf9be3d080e370e124f75f4b1d8dbb731c.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/54cda07e7749f212c7852e23c41562d873bce2eb.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Cosmetics
This Means Warp now has hats! Unlock a selection of hats and accessories to outfit your characters and show off the coolest croc in the galaxy. All cosmetics are free to unlock - no microtransactions or lootboxes!

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/9f8946e684918e2354d64784d339202698587967.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/2bd67acee9bb9d79bfdc02e27cd4e6b17a03f9a4.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/b9817e885f3f9eab5857a6fa30830aeeec819e24.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Ship Mods
The Ship Mod system has been completely overhauled, with players able to install new rarity-based modifiers in one of three available slots. Mods are also purchasable from the shop, and feature several new variants to help build synergies with the systems on your ship.

New mods include:

Mutiny - an enemy crew member will turn against their own ship for a short duration
Evasion - enemy projectiles miss for a short duration
Improved tick rate for beam guns
Increased damage for ricochet projectiles
Increased radius for AOE projectiles
Increased damage multiplier on weakened systems
Increased slow effect for slowed systems
Faster gun overheat recovery
Faster timers on offensive bombs

Other Improvements
Improved AI
Faster decision making, intelligent repair prioritisation, new AI for boarding other ships, dropping packages rather than destroying them, and more!

Balance overhaul
The new mod system leads to a lot more opportunities for synergy and ramping up your ship's power, so the game's balancing has also been updated to include updated shop prices and reroll system, enemy health changes, and tweaked difficulty.

2x New sector mods
Maps that increase the risk of permanent damage, or randomly set fire to systems on both the player and enemy ships.

2x New weapons
The Grenade Launcher lobs AOE grenades, and the Rainbow Laser fires lasers with random effects each round.

10x New missions
Includes unique characters, visuals, and backgrounds.

Lots of minor bug fixes


With Update 4 we feel This Means Warp is in great shape for full release, and look forward to sharing some special surprises for the 1.0 update later this year. If you enjoy the new content and have a few moments to spare please do take a second to leave a Steam review, and you can chat to the developers directly on Discord as well!

notes.title: Update 3 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Today marks the launch of Update 3, featuring a host of new content and systems for This Means Warp!

Update 3 Release Notes
AI Control
One of the most requested features from players finally arrives in This Means Warp! You now have full control over AI crewmates, and can tell them which systems you do (or don't) want them to use on the ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/d6d5fa0337bfa97a0590a19f39e2104320a3f659.png

New Missions
Multi-Ship Battles
Take on two ships at once with new combat missions featuring challenging battles against multiple enemies.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/5acadeccf1ae120cad5fbdb994cb66cd16478be4.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/3d225828cb5c65ce4cba5d71d68a941dce259324.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/38a090e0a0e8b0d517826fe984fde6cf5522b587.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

The number of possible enemy ship layouts has also been expanded, with new enemies to face and new strategies to discover.

New Survival Mission
It's getting hot in here... A new survival mission has been added featuring a nearby star. Get those extinguishers ready!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/9f62a48e4887cb7b489cac5b296bec903f0866ef.png

Ship Systems
Taunt Beacon
Put those health upgrades to good use in the new Taunt Beacon subsystem, absorbing enemy projectiles and damage for a set duration. Be careful -  enemies may have them too so you'll need to take them down or time your damage carefully to get past them.

Trubble Gun
Those pesky Trubbles are back, this time hurtling from a cannon! Slow enemy systems with area of effect damage from the new Trubble Gun.

Ship Mods
Two new ship modifiers are available to collect after completing a boss fight. Buy yourself some time by slowing all enemy systems, or by temporarily stunning their entire crew.


Update 3 also includes a number of minor bug fixes and balance tweaks. We'd love to hear what you think so if you haven't already come and chat to us on Discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269300/

notes.title: Update 2 Is Here!
notes.notes:
We're delighted to announce that This Means Warp's second major Early Access update is now available! This update includes a host of changes, focused around the areas most requested by players - missions, quality of life improvements, and AI.

Update 2 Release Notes
Missions
10x New Decision Events
We've added a host of new random events during a run, from pirates raiding ancient ruins to merchant ships leaking spacepuffs. These additional dialogue choices enable greater variation and ensure there's always something new to discover each time you play. As part of this, the dialogue choice system has also been expanded to enable multi-stage conversations with the characters you meet along the way.

New Training Mission Type
Building on the crew progression system introduced in Update 1, friendly merchants can now offer you the chance to improve character stats for you and your crew.

New Item Swap Mission Type
Merchants will now sometimes look to trade for an existing system on your ship rather than cash.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/9b543274f87d846da8849e268d278d40eb6a4c94.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/37d3c939c1ef6f6401dd7169e374fa3c88c6c64f.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/2bf78e3a6c840dd49203217de285591d8b2db3c2.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Merchants aren't always friendly - they can now also confront the player and appear in battles if you get on their bad side!

Quality Of Life
"Inspect" Button
Tired of waiting for an item or upgrade so that you can see your system stats? You can now use the dedicated button to inspect an item during gameplay.

Reroll Shop
If there's nothing you fancy in a shop you can now reroll for a new selection of items. Use it sparingly - it doesn't come cheap!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/dd8062eda07dad56045b96aed1d099d95b734a99.png

Skip Intro Cutscene
You can now skip the intro cinematic if gameplay has fully loaded before it ends.

Crew AI
Packages
Crew members will now automatically pick up ammo, toolboxes, etc from the floor if available rather than always heading back to the dispenser.

Shields
Crew members will now actively use shields to block incoming damage.

Survival
When entering a Survival mission crew members will start getting ready before the ship takes damage.

Bonus
Bee Gun
A new bee-themed unlockable weapon type featuring a new "slow" effect that impacts target systems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/04cb5403ec44a105afde0fa95e4807ec68905422.png

We hope you have fun with the new content! If you have enjoyed This Means Warp, please leave a review on Steam to help others discover the game. You can also drop us a note on the Steam forums or chat to us on Discord - we'd love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: TMW Development Update - May 30th 2022
notes.notes:
This Means Warp’s first big content drop launched a few weeks ago (full details here), and we’re now hard at work on loads more changes as part of Update 2!

What are you working on?
The full feature list for Update 2 will be revealed soon, but in the meantime there are three big areas we’re focusing on:

 Mission variation
 Quality of life improvements
 Crew AI

Most of Update 2 is based on player feedback, including many features that have been directly requested by the community. If you’d like to have your say, join us on Discord - your suggestions may well make it into the next update!

How has the Early Access roadmap changed since launch?
This Means Warp’s Early Access development roadmap was shaped based on Alpha and Beta player feedback, but with the influx of new Early Access players we now have even more ideas and suggestions to integrate into the game!

The most common request around launch was for more replayability, so Update 1 was adjusted to feature a lot of additional content once you’ve completed the main story. Update 2, on the other hand, focuses more around areas that can become tedious after many runs (hello “Skip Intro” and “Inspect Item” buttons!).

We have more updates planned in the future, and will continue to adapt the changes based on input from This Means Warp’s community.

When will Update 2 be released?
Exact date TBD, but we’re aiming for late June 2022.

Any other news?
We were very excited to see our “Best Upcoming Game” award arrive in the post, and if you're looking for some cool new games to try, we're also participating in the Dreamhack Beyond Festival for the next week!

notes.title: TMW Update 1 Out NOW, With A 20% Discount To Celebrate!
notes.notes:
In the six weeks since Early Access launch we've been working feverishly to bring lots of new content to This Means Warp. We're delighted to announce that Update 1 is available NOW, along with a 20% discount to celebrate Steam's "Going Rogue" festival!

Update 1 contains a wealth of new features for This Means Warp, including a series of unique gameplay scenarios, new ship colors, new enemies, missions, modifiers, and more. Check out the full details below.

If you've been thinking about picking up This Means Warp, now is the perfect time to jump in! Many of the new features in Update 1 are based on feedback from our community, and we'd love to hear what you want to see in Update 2. Join us on Discord to chat to the developers directly, or drop a comment on the Steam Discussions board. See you there!

Update 1 Release Notes

New Game Modes
4x Gameplay Scenarios
Test your skills in 4 curated gameplay Scenarios that challenge you to think differently about your tactics and strategy.

Each Scenario also comes with a unique Ship Tint to unlock, allowing you to customize the colors of your ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/a07b998bebfc59c605338a0545415bd9a55b3262.png

Custom Mode
Create your own challenge with a new Scenario Creator tool that allows you to set variables and define your own custom parameters before starting a run.

Nightmare Difficulty
Push yourself to the limit with a new infinitely scaling difficulty mode. Climb the ladder to see how far you can reach!

New Features
Crew Progression
Your crew now level up as you progress, gaining XP and developing their skills throughout a run. Recruiting crew members also now has more differentiation and variation each time you play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/913632dd78fb69464a614c02ad06678944b623b2.png

New Content
Enemy Ships
The number of late-game enemy ships has been greatly expanded, with 4 new layouts (plus additional variants) to add more variety to battles towards the end of a run.

Rain down destruction with the new Fire Ammo Ship Modifier, or defend against those pesky Fire Beams with an automated Extinguisher Ship Modifier.

notes.title: Balance Patch 4.02
notes.notes:
Some small tweaks to balancing as a result of player feedback.

Easy Difficulty: 
Bot Movement modifier increased from 0.8 to 0.85
Progression Modifier increased from 0.8 to 0.85
Enemy Ammo Respawn duration decreased from 1.4 to 1.3

Multi-gun rarity modifiers:
4 guns: 0.5  -> 0.7
5 guns: 0.4 -> 0.6

Boss 2:
Offensive window has been reduced by 5s
Health curve has been flattened reducing HP by roughly 10%

Boss 3:
Timer for the primary mechanic has been reduced from 45s to 38s
Overall health range increased from 50-200 to 75-270

notes.title: This Means Warp Update Notes - 10th September
notes.notes:
With PAX behind us and the demo for This Means Warp a few weeks away, we thought we'd share some of the things we've been working on based on feedback from the beta!

What's New?
Missions

The game's procedural generation is now seed-based, meaning you can enter a specific seed and recreate a run, or replay your friends' runs with the same maps, missions, items and encounters.
New 'Trubbles' minigame - a frantic race to incinerate troublesome critters before they overrun the ship.
New 'Doubloons' minigame - don your space suits and dodge speeding debris to collect as many pirate doubloons as you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461814/ddaebefb325ce4a54ce17e994757239031c0b6a3.png

Story

New intro cutscene.
New messages from the Norg to decipher as you progress through the story.
Updated tooltips.

Items

New 'Repair Pulse' system to repair lots of items around the ship at once and stay on top of AOE damage.

Other

Completely rewritten crew AI.
Mouse controls for aiming.
Localization support for multiple languages.
Lots of bug fixes and performance improvements.


To see more sneak peeks of upcoming features, chat to the developers, or share you feedback, join us on Discord today!

You can also try This Means Warp yourself - the demo will be available on Steam from October 1st! Sign up to the newsletter at www.ThisMeansWarp.com for a reminder.
